title: USSH Opus 4.7 + 1M Context Bolster — Dormant Infrastructure Activation, Context Expansion, AI Internals Wiring
brief: Maximize Opus 4.7's 1M context ceiling to bolster comprehensive skill/script/hook coverage, internal system utilization, memories, container skills always-on, self-awareness, CLAUDE.md files, precompact/compact/handoff, slash commands, and the PRISM inventory system. Activate dormant infrastructure (Ollama, Docker, Qdrant) and wire 32 unused AI engines into the tool-call loop. User quote: 'think of what else we have that we can bolster with a higher token usage ceiling and fully utilize opus 4.7 to the max — include PRISM inventory system, ollama/docker integration, and audit what's dormant/underutilized'.
description: Three-phase milestone to fully utilize Opus 4.7's 1M context ceiling by: (A) activating dormant infrastructure (Ollama, Docker, Qdrant, ModelRouting, 8 inventory engines, neural ONNX stack), (B) bolstering SessionStart/CLAUDE.md/handoff/compact with rich always-on state loading up to 80K tier-1 budget, (C) wiring dormant AGI engines (WorldSimulator, BayesianInference, CausalReasoning, AutonomousGoal, CuriosityQueue, CognitiveBudgetAllocator) into session lifecycle for compounding self-improvement.
